title: Ladies Day 2023
subtitle: Southwest Division Ladies Day events of 2023, club by club.

sections.heading: April 12, 2023 - Ladies Day at Newport Harbor LBC
body: Ladies Day was held at the Newport Harbor LBC.  A big thank you to the hospitality of Newport Harbor with breakfast goodies along with luncheon salads and other yummy items.  Thanks you to Karen Billon, Jan Hargraves, Le Anderson, Lisa Milligan, Nancy Santos, Norma Goodhart for all their help bringing food and setting up.  Also Heather Stewart for bringing her delicious heavenly hash dessert.  Let’s not forget to thank Diana Wenzel and Shelley Cohen for being Ladies’ Day coordinators (our job is easy when everyone shows up and no last minute changes, so thanks)

WOW!!!  We had such a fabulous turnout with 50 ladies from 12 different SW Division clubs.  What a way to start our Ladies Day bowling year.   I want to thank each and every lady who participated, especially those who drove a far distance.  The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC,  Oaks North LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Redlands LBC, Riverside LBC, Santa Ana and Santa Anita LBC.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Norma Goodhart           Connie Delgado            Molly Smulian
2nd Place:          Holly Gross                   Charlyn Moltane           Joyce Johnson
3rd Place:         Jan Hargraves               Barbara Krause             Lisa Milligan
4th Place:          Lee Ang                        Edie Beyer                    Melinda Riddle
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:           Lee Ang                        Jean Namontes
2nd Place  tie:     Diana Wenzel               Catherine Major            Le Anderson
2nd Place tie:     Shelley Cohen               Charlyn Moltane           Molly Smulian
3rd Place:            Norma Goodhart          Shirley Lewis                 Debbie Reichle
Congratulations to all the winners.
I hope we can keep the momentum going and have the same turnout at our next Ladies Day - May 10th at Long Beach LBC.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: May 10 2023 - Ladies Day at Long Beach LBC
body: Ladies Day was held at the Long Beach LBC.  A big thank you for their hospitality throughout the day and the rinks being set up when we got there, even with practice mats and jacks so we didn’t have to take from the game mats.

We had another terrific turnout with 46 ladies from 12 different SW Division clubs.  Everything ran smoothly and we all had a fun day bowling.  The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Oaks North LBC, Redlands LBC, Riverside LBC, Santa Ana and Santa Anita LBC.
The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time and we hope to continue seeing them:  Connie Fortier, Cindy Phan, Jackie Kovach, Manya Urane and Winnona Dancy.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place:           Beverly Ponder             Madeline Wilson           Jackie Kovach
2nd Place:          Inger Benson                Connie Fortier               June Ralph
3rd Place:         Norma Goodhart           Jeri DeCastro                Peggy Torrance

I hope we can keep the momentum going and have the same turnout at our next Ladies Day – June 14th (location to be announced soon)
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: July 12 2023 - Ladies Day at Coronado LBC
body: Ladies Day was held at the Coronado LBC.  A big thank you to the hospitality of Coronado for providing a wonderful selection of salads and goodies for us.  A special thanks to Barbara Lee and Berie Grobe for organizing this event.  Coronado has such a beautiful facility and it is a pleasure to bowl there.  This was our first Ladies Day in the San Diego County area and everyone enjoyed their day.

Thank you to all the ladies who drove the distance to attend this Ladies Day.   The clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol, Coronado LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Oaks North LBC and San Diego LBC.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played  and the winners were:
1st Place:           Trish Soto                     Sandy Graham              Catherine Major
2nd Place:          Nancy Santos                Shelley Cohen               Patty Doidge
3rd Place:         Diana Wenzel               Julie Kimura                  Katy Christensen
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:

2nd Place:          Trish Soto                     Julie Kimura                  Katy Christensen
3rd Place:            Norma Goodhart          Judith Ziegler                Lisa Milligan
Congratulations to all the winners.
Looking forward to our next Ladies Day at Laguna Beach LBC on August 9, 2023.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: August 9 2023 - Ladies Day at Laguna Beach LBC
body: Ladies Day was held at the Laguna Beach LBC.  A big thank you to Jackie Kelly who was in charge of hospitality,  We were greeted with a very nice display for breakfast and an even greater selection of salads and homemade desserts for lunch.  Of course, what could be greater than lawn bowling with a beautiful view of the ocean.

We had a full house with 50 ladies from 9 different SW Division clubs.  It is so wonderful to see the green 100% full and everyone having such a great time.   Clubs joining us for the day were Casta del Sol LBC, Hermosa Beach LBC, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC, Oaks North LBC and Santa Ana LBC.

The following ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time and we hope to continue seeing them:  Ginny Barrett, Tory Ruppert, Carol Dayn, Grace Hallum and also Keetje Berndt returning after many years.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:

Our next Ladies Day will be Wednesday, September 13th at The Groves.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day co-chairs

sections.heading: LADIES DAY November 8, 2023
body: A big thank you to Casta del Sol for hosting Ladies Day.  We had spectacular hospitality starting with a wonderful breakfast selection followed by great salads, fruit and desserts for lunch.  To top off the day, ice cream bars were served along with a huge selection of cookies.   We had a great turnout once again with 44 Ladies from the following clubs:  Casta del Sol LBC, The Groves LBC, Hermosa Beach, Holmby LBC, Laguna Beach LBC, Laguna Woods LBC, Long Beach LBC, Newport Harbor LBC and Oaks North LBC.  Thanks to all these clubs participating and making this such a fun day.
We had two ladies join us for the first time at Ladies Day:  Mary Ellen Lamparter and Ann Sakamoto, both from Casta del Sol.  I hope to see them at future Ladies Day.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place:            Trish Soto                     Keetje Berndt               Aileen Broccardo
2nd Place:           Shelley Cohen               Peggy Torrance             Mary Ellen Lamparter
3rd Place:         Doreen Hall                  Lisa Milligan                  Anne Sakamoto
4th Place:          Julie Kimura                  Val Blackholly
5th Place           Holly Gross                   Cindy Jones                   Malinda Riddle
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place:            Inger Benson                Cindy Jones                   Barbara Hardesty
2nd Place:           Irene Myrold                 Lisa Milligan                  Ann Sakamoto
3rd Place:         Norma Goodhart           Debbie Lewis                Carol Kangas
4th Place:         Kathy Yezarski           Jerri DeCastro             Malinda Riddle
Congratulations to all the winners.
Our next Ladies Day will be the Holiday Luncheon at Laguna Woods LBC on Tuesday, December 12th.  Be sure to see the flyer posted at your club.  This is a really fun way to end our year.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: LADIES DAY HOLIDAY LUNCHEON TUESDAY, DECEMBER 12, 2023
body: We did it again.  With the support of the wonderful ladies from various clubs, our Holiday Luncheon was a huge success.  Thanks to Laguna Woods LBC for hosting the morning game for our bowlers.  Our bowlers and attendees came out in festive outfits and the fun never ended throughout the day.   A special thanks to Heather Stewart for donating her handmade holiday table runner to raise money for SouthWest Division.  The special raffle was a huge success.
The winners of our morning game were:
1st Place:          Tricia Quan                       Phyllis Mitchell                   Carol Petyo
2nd Place:         Mary Spease                     Jeri DeCastro                       Sybil Moore
3rd Place tie:   Norma Goodhart            Ramona Loucks
3rd Place tie:   Margi Rambo                   Maureen Kennedy             Callie Roth
Congratulations to all the winners.

This Holiday Luncheon was a terrific ending to an amazing year of Ladies Day events.  We are looking forward to continuing our success in 2024.  Our schedule should be available by late January and our games will begin in March.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel
Norma Goodhart for co-chairing the Luncheon
Ladies Day Coordinators

migrationNotes: Five of the six 2023 posts sit at placeholder Squarespace URLs ("blog-post-title-one-yt94b", "...-cp6gz", "...-mz9cl", "...-mz9cl-za443", "...-mz9cl-za443-fpnlk", "...-mz9cl-za443-fpnlk-wmlrf"). The displayed titles were real and have been kept; only the URLs were never renamed.
Two headings are in the source's original all-capitals ("LADIES DAY November 8, 2023" and "LADIES DAY HOLIDAY LUNCHEON TUESDAY, DECEMBER 12, 2023"). Kept as written rather than re-cased.
The April, May, July and November 2023 posts have no photos on the source page, so those events carry text only.

The one photo on the August 9 (Laguna Beach) post was uploaded as "Corenado_LD.jpg" and shows a clubhouse that does not match Laguna Beach LBC - it looks like the Coronado club from the July event. Carried across under a neutral filename; the club may want to check it.
There is no March, June, September or October 2023 post on the source site.
Source posts were dated only "Apr 10" (the Squarespace re-import date, 2025). Author byline "SWD Webmaster" dropped.
